_comment: A one-time run (POST /api/2.1/jobs/runs/submit) of dbr_install_check.py, filled by `dbx_runs.py spec --template this --target TARGET --notebook NAME --sha SHA --out FILE` and submitted by `dbx_runs.py submit --json FILE`. Every <KEY> is filled from arguments and SDM_DBX_* environment variables; no workspace value is written here. A classic single-node job cluster under the given cluster policy, created for this run alone; cloud attributes, log delivery and extra tags come from SDM_DBX_CLUSTER_EXTRA. The notebook is imported beforehand as a NEW file; no existing notebook, cluster or job is touched.
